The first change removes unpriced links and relay nodes that cannot participate in any valid source-to-destination broadcast route. This reduces both memory use and the `O(3^k · |V|)` subset-DP work without excluding any cost-valid directed Steiner tree.

The second change extends exact shared-tree optimization from ten to twelve destinations. Since the graph is now pruned to relevant relays first, this remains practical for typical cloud-region topologies while improving cost for configurations with 11–12 destinations that previously used the less accurate greedy fallback.
